messages.content: I talked it through with my spouse. Please verify the actual sleeping setup and the complete five-night cost for both St. Louis hotels before we decide. There are three of us, and I do not want a room that only works if the hotel brings in a rollaway.

For March 16 through March 21, both available room types accept three registered guests without a rollaway. The Clayton option is a one-bedroom suite with one queen bed in the bedroom and a full-size pullout sofa in the living room. The Drury option is a standard room with two queen beds. I am checking the tax, parking, breakfast, deposit, and cancellation details against the current rates now.
Good. Also tell me whether the sofa bed is guaranteed as part of that room type, not just something that might be available.

It is guaranteed in the named one-bedroom suite category. The room description and occupancy record both specify one queen bed plus one full-size sofa bed, with a maximum occupancy of four. The Drury reservation would guarantee two queen beds and has a maximum occupancy of four as well.
What are the totals once every required hotel charge is included? Break out parking so I can see why the earlier numbers looked different.

The Clayton suite is $1,325.00 for five nights, plus $190.00 in lodging taxes and fees, for $1,515.00. Self-parking is $18 per night, adding $90.00, so the complete stay is $1,605.00. The Drury room is $1,002.00, taxes and fees are $146.00, and parking is also $18 per night, or $90.00. Its complete total is $1,238.00. The Drury is therefore $367.00 less for the same five nights.
That clears it up. Are both breakfasts actually included for all three of us? My daughter is fourteen, if that affects the charge.

Yes. Both rates include breakfast for all registered guests, including your fourteen-year-old. Clayton provides a buffet with hot items, fruit, cereal, pastries, and made-to-order eggs on some mornings. Drury provides a hot breakfast with eggs, breakfast meat, potatoes, waffles, fruit, and cereal. Drury also includes its evening reception with hot food and nonalcoholic drinks, which could replace a light dinner on one or two nights.
And the cancellation terms? We are driving, so weather flexibility matters more than paying later by a few days.

Clayton allows cancellation without penalty until 6:00 p.m. local time three days before arrival; after that, the penalty is one night plus tax. Drury allows free cancellation until 6:00 p.m. local time the day before arrival, then charges one night plus tax. Neither rate requires prepayment. Both hotels place a card guarantee now and collect the room balance at checkout, though each may authorize an incidental hold at check-in.
So Drury is cheaper and gives us two actual beds, a later cancellation deadline, and breakfast. How does the location affect the activities we discussed?

Drury is the more practical base for the planned Forest Park days: it is about a 7- to 10-minute drive from the park attractions, depending on traffic. Clayton is roughly 12 to 18 minutes away. For the Fox Theatre and downtown day, Drury also avoids adding meaningful drive time. The $50 local-parking allowance still covers the Fox and downtown outings; hotel parking is already included in each total I quoted.

Then I do not think the separate room is worth another $367 on this trip. Reserve the Drury two-queen room for all five nights. Make sure the reservation lists three guests and does not switch us to a king room.

The Drury two-queen room is reserved for three guests from March 16 through March 21 under confirmation STL-DRY-58341. The guaranteed room type is two queen beds; no rollaway or sofa bed is needed. The complete hotel total is $1,238.00, consisting of $1,002.00 room charges, $146.00 taxes and fees, and $90.00 parking. Hot breakfast for all three guests and the evening reception are included. Payment is due at checkout, and free cancellation ends at 6:00 p.m. St. Louis time on March 15. With $175 estimated fuel and $50 for Fox and downtown parking, the current trip base is $1,463.00 before other meals and activities.
